speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do you think singing can bring happiness to people?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Yeah, absolutely, of course. That's the reason so many people love listening to music — it makes them feel better. Singing is, at its core, about expressing feelings, and when you sing, other people can feel what you feel — it's like a strengthened way of sharing emotions. And maybe some songs match exactly what you're going through. Then you realize that somewhere out there, someone has felt the same way as you — and you feel you're not alone. That's how singing brings people happiness.
